intro.title: Winston room guide
intro.text: I'm Winston. Pause over an object, or reach it with your keyboard, and I'll explain what it does. You can turn this guide off at any time.

phone.title: Winston
phone.text: Use the phone to speak with Winston, ask questions, and request a desk briefing.

music.title: Apple Music
music.text: The pocket player opens Apple Music, where you can connect your account and choose what to play.

journal.title: Trade journal
journal.text: Open the journal to review your trades, record lessons, and reflect on your decisions.

keyboard.title: Command
keyboard.text: The keyboard opens Command, with your watchlist, trading configuration, and desk controls.

trackpad.title: Performance
trackpad.text: The trackpad opens Performance, where you can review closed trades and the results available for this bot.

notes.title: Bull Report and notes
notes.text: The bull and bear open your Bull Report and notes, bringing your written market observations together.

lamp.title: Risk and Bull Matrix
lamp.text: The lamp opens Risk and Bull Matrix, where you can review position limits, risk capacity, and the checks before a trade.

mission.title: Session Brief
mission.text: The framed brief brings together your mission, calendar, and watchlist. Start here to review the session.

vault.title: Vault checks
vault.text: The shelf safe opens Vault checks, where you can review workspace access and connection checks.

research.title: Saved research
research.text: The desk drawer opens saved research. Search your collected notes and revisit useful findings.

pen.title: Approvals
pen.text: The pen opens Approvals, where you can review pending proposals before deciding what to approve.

bookshelf.title: Strategy library
bookshelf.text: The books open the Strategy Library, where you can revisit the methods and reference material available in this workspace.

clock.title: Market sessions
clock.text: The clock opens Market sessions, with market hours and session information.

tv.title: Trading screen
tv.text: The desktop monitor shows your trading chart. Use its expand button for a larger view.

broadcast.title: Broadcast
broadcast.text: The wall screen opens Broadcast. Choose a channel, watch the stream, or manage your channel list from Tools.

window.title: Market conditions
window.text: The window shortcut opens Market conditions for a broader view of the market context.
